description: pkix-lint/src/report.rs line 58: The serde bound is serde(bound(deserialize = "'de: 'static")), which constrains all deserializers to have a 'static lifetime. This is required because EvaluationReport fields transitively use de_cow_static, which constructs Cow::Owned from a String, making the data 'static. However, this bound is unusual and may surprise callers trying to deserialize from a non-'static source (e.g., a borrowed byte slice via serde_json::from_slice). The serde bound is not documented in the struct doc comment or # Errors section. Callers who see serde derives and try to use serde_json::from_slice will get a confusing compiler error about lifetime requirements. Add a doc comment noting the 'de: 'static bound and why it exists.
title: P2: EvaluationReport serde bound is 'de: 'static — required at deserialize call site, not documented
